Constraints: detailed and crafted yet exceptionally readable; existing 8px rounded controls and surfaces, restrained shared brass, parchment text on neutral charcoal. Body text not decorative serif. No gameplay promises, play tutorial button, additional rules or fake controls. Preserve written tutorial content. No watermark.
